scene.name: Coreworks Overworld
scene.purpose: Untimed prologue and persistent recovery hub before The Shard Foundry

plates.name: Western Signal Flats
plates.story_function: Optional untimed survey route with Signal Sweep, Trillian recovery, the field harness, and sealed salvage

plates.name: Landing Flats
plates.story_function: Solitary arrival, Aryn's ship, safe movement, and the first voluntary journey into the world

plates.name: Dras Outpost
plates.story_function: Discovery of Dras Ehdre, his lived-in base camp, the abandoned exchange, and the human cost of the collapse

plates.name: Coreworks Threshold
plates.story_function: Failed atmospheric infrastructure, volcanic threat, and the Coreworks portal

camera.notes: The overworld is intentionally one screen high. The camera scrolls horizontally across one continuous panorama.

collision.art_contract: Continuous walkable desert and buried freight-road surface
Single harmless jump-sized rock or broken freight slab

anchors.label: Survey echo plinth
anchors.notes: Unlocks Signal Sweep and awards one Galactic Credit.

anchors.label: Trillian
anchors.notes: Separate from Jane. Non-solid, non-hostile, and surface-only.

anchors.label: Trillian field harness
anchors.notes: Unlocks powered launch and the noncombat salvage breach.

anchors.label: Sealed western salvage
anchors.notes: Requires Trillian's field harness and awards five Galactic Credits.

anchors.label: Aryn's ship
anchors.notes: Separate transparent asset. Brightest cyan landmark on Plate 1.

anchors.label: Dras Ehdre
anchors.notes: He is beyond the starting viewport. Aryn must leave the ship and jog into Plate 2 before discovering him.

anchors.label: Dras's camp
anchors.notes: Patched awning, folding chair, kettle, tool case, radio, and Coreworks-part wind chime.

anchors.label: Worker Droid
anchors.notes: Non-solid and non-hostile. Drifts above the Outpost ground and periodically descends into a dust-producing maintenance cycle near the abandoned credit terminal.

anchors.label: Coreworks portal
anchors.notes: Brightest cyan-green landmark on Plate 3. Entering it starts the eight-minute level timer.

anchors.label: Vesper volcano
anchors.notes: Orange crater glow with an unnatural cyan underglow tied to the Resonant.

parallax_layers.art: Indigo-to-dusty-rose dusk gradient with sparse stars
Continuous mountain range and volcano silhouette
Closer eroded ridges and Vesperite fault glints
Collapsed viaduct, leaning towers, broken cables, and sand-buried worker housing
Playable desert, buried freight road, rocks, and sparse hardy vegetation
Dust ribbons, heat shimmer, and occasional windblown debris

ambient_motion.implementation: Three transparent sprites moving at different speeds
Slow smoke drift with rare orange and cyan crater pulses
Sparse dust ribbons and subtle foreground vegetation movement
Scarf and coat movement, amber probe flicker, blink, and occasional glance
Cyan core breathing light and restrained magenta navigation blink
Worker banner, wind chime, kettle vapor, and radio-static pulse
Slow horizontal hover drift with a clean manipulation loop and periodic low-hover service animation
Alternating sky passes plus a guide-circle over the next unfinished Western Signal Flats assignment
Unarmored and armored follow loops, powered jump launch with physics arc, and noncombat salvage breach

story_beats.beat: Aryn can travel west to trace a survey echo and unlock Signal Sweep.
Aryn recovers Trillian as an optional non-solid surface companion.
The field harness changes Trillian's gait and unlocks powered traversal.
Trillian breaches sealed salvage without entering a combat or damage state.
Aryn arrives beside her ship. The scene is safe and untimed, and either direction is open.
A single low obstacle quietly confirms movement and jumping while the rightward story route remains clear.
Aryn discovers Dras and his base camp. He explains Vesperite, the infestation, the abandoned workforce, and the Coreworks.
The worker droid offers an optional service assignment after Dras clears first contact.
Failed atmospheric infrastructure foreshadows the toxic timer.
Aryn enters the Coreworks portal; the eight-minute mission begins.

master_panorama.instruction: Treat the four plates as one continuous panorama split at x=1672, x=3344, and x=5016.

art_contract.split_rule: No foreground hero prop or interaction zone may straddle x=1672, x=3344, or x=5016. Mountains, sky, clouds, and distant ruins may cross seams continuously.
